name: IC Memory — SPI, 3.6V — WSON
description: Surface-mount SPI memory ICs rated for 3.6V in WSON-8 footprints, available in 6x5mm and 8x6mm package options.
selection_hints: Select based on required package footprint dimensions, either 6x5mm or 8x6mm WSON-8.
Prefer tier A parts such as W25Q128JVP, W25Q32JVZP, or W25X20CLZP over tier B options.
Ensure system compatibility with SPI interface and 3.6V rating.
avoid_when: The board design requires package families other than WSON or through-hole mounting.
The target circuit operates at a voltage rating other than 3.6V or uses a non-SPI interface.
Footprint dimensions other than WSON-8-1EP 6x5mm or 8x6mm are required.
